name: nextbeat
description: NextBeat (PayCall) — metered x402 investigation beats on Hedera testnet

scripts.dev: concurrently --names service,agent --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @nextbeat/service" "npm run dev -w @nextbeat/agent"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nextbeat/shared && npm run build -w @nextbeat/service && npm run build -w @nextbeat/agent
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @nextbeat/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
